critical_distinctions: Recursive dispatch receives GET; the original Request is retained.
The wrapper creates a null-body Response from the awaited dispatch result.
Wrapper rejection does not imply guaranteed local error handling.
Direct nullish fallback does not consult finalized and is outside the direct handler catch.
Truthy Promise results win; falsy results use finalized response or not-found.
Composition awaits handlers, skips falsy assignments, and checks finalization in the application catch scope.
Composition assigns a truthy result only for finalized === false or isError.
The setter can replace storage; earlier merge failure can prevent final assignment.
The getter does not finalize; cookie and content-type handling remain distinct.
i <= index rejects before the child handler catch.
An awaiting parent can handle an Error with onError; callback await behavior is unknown.
Guard failure is not claimed to bypass every error handler.
Storage existence and finalized are distinct.
Getter, setter, direct next, Promise selection, nested middleware, and composed finalization participate.
No claim of complete application-state coverage.
Unknown runtime handler selection, returns, effects, writes, failures, and await behavior.
Custom callback behavior is not inferred from local defaults.
No purity or complete runtime graph claim.
